title: Seat belt comfort and buckle issues
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on seat belt discomfort around the neck, difficult buckling, warning or fault indications, and a few buckle or retractor repairs.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe seat belts rubbing or digging into the neck, being uncomfortable or hard to latch, and buckle fault codes involving open circuits.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention suggested seat belt improvement, warning icons staying on, buckle or retractor service, and restraint behavior changes without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment beyond the clearly negative comfort and buckle-fault reports.
Some fragments appear to reference another vehicle name in the text, so model/topic attribution in the sample may be noisy.
The topic mixes comfort complaints with warning-light, wiring, buckle, and retractor service mentions rather than one single issue.
